topline.text: The DfE's twin SEND reform consultations — on education otherwise than at school (EOTAS) and a new 'local SEND inclusion formula' funding mainstream schools upfront — close at 11.59pm tonight.
topline.action: Last call to get any outstanding MAPs school responses in before the deadline.

topline.text: Sheffield City Council is bringing a new learning places strategy to committee, proposing extra specialist SEND places and a 'joined-up approach' to exclusions and alternative provision after a sustained rise in both.
topline.action: Worth tracking as it moves through committee — directly touches AP and SEND placements for partner schools.

diary.text: DfE's twin SEND/EOTAS reform consultations close tonight at 11.59pm.
Deadline for academy trusts to submit their budget forecast return, per this week's DfE Update.

items.body: The DfE's linked consultations on reforming education otherwise than at school and on a new local SEND inclusion formula — which would front-load more SEND funding to mainstream schools rather than via top-ups — both close at 11.59pm tonight. Existing EHCPs stay protected until 2030; the government's response is expected in autumn.
items.action: If any MAPs partner school hasn't responded, today is the last chance.

items.lede: New learning places strategy aims to tackle SEND demand and exclusions together.
items.body: Councillors are considering a city-wide learning places strategy proposing extra specialist SEND places and a joined-up approach linking exclusions, alternative provision and SEND placement decisions — responding to a sustained rise in both exclusions and SEND demand. Children with SEND, from disadvantaged backgrounds and from ethnic minority communities remain over-represented in exclusion figures, the report notes.
items.action: Flag to partner schools once a committee date is confirmed — this is the strategy that will shape AP commissioning locally.

items.lede: DfE pushes back two autumn deadlines.
items.body: This week's DfE Update moves the operational deadline for autumn-census free school meal eligibility checks from 1 October to 2 November, giving schools more time to implement the new Universal Credit-based FSM expansion, while academy trusts get until 24 September for budget forecast returns.
items.action: Useful breathing room if FSM re-checks are still in progress for MAPs schools.

box.label: Jargon-buster - EOTAS
box.intro: Cropping up a lot in today's SEND coverage:
box.text: Education Otherwise Than At School — provision for children who can't attend a mainstream or special school placement, e.g. home tuition, hospital education or approved online providers. Tonight's consultation proposes new statutory guidance for how councils commission and quality-assure it.
